decisions.reason: The transactional email service is a flagship of the firm's cloud messaging strategy and fits the growing demand for API-based communication.
Document capture supports the firm's electronic document workflow direction and benefits from ongoing digitalization of business processes.
Email and fax conversion uses existing infrastructure at low cost and still serves regulated customers who rely on fax.
The fax optimization feature is embedded in the established fax service and is cheap to maintain, despite fax's long-term decline.
Sandbox threat protection is central to an email security portfolio facing rising ransomware and phishing threats.
